expected.title: Chow groups with modulus versus Suslin homology for smooth projective varieties over perfect fields with regular reduced-divisor components, after inverting positive characteristic or modulo nonzero integers in characteristic zero
expected.author: Federico Binda; Amalendu Krishna
expected.difficulty_reason: The cited nilpotent-invariance theorem does not turn an arbitrary Suslin rational-equivalence relation into an admissible modulus relation on the given variety. The authors embed the normalization curve into a projective bundle and construct blowups that enforce the required transverse intersections with the regular divisor components. That geometric reduction and the final comparison of the two relation presentations establish the isomorphism with the specified coefficients.
